amendments.before: Gif ðēos ęlcung nǣre, wē wǣren ōðerne sīð cumen.
amendments.after: Gif ðēos ęlcung nǣre, wē wǣren ōðre sīðe cumen.
amendments.reason: 44.7: actual §176 is adverbial instrumental, hence supplied ōðre sīðe. 46.1: possessive agrees with genitive father. 47.5: reuse actual taught and explicitly source-attested third-singular exception funde; fand remains valid alternative.
